entities.summary: Francis Milton Kornet is an American former professional basketball player who was selected by the Milwaukee Bucks in the second round of the 1989 NBA draft. Kornet played two seasons in the NBA, both with the Bucks. In his NBA career, he appeared in a total of 89 games and averaged 1.9 ppg. He graduated from Lexington Catholic High School and played collegiately at Vanderbilt University from 1985 to 1989. He was named all-Southeastern Conference in his senior year.
